description: Public registry for Delx wellness MCP connectors.

hosted_hub_boundary.note: This repository catalogs local-first connectors and shared schemas. Hosted token vault, billing, API keys, rate limiting, and private user data are intentionally out of scope.

connectors.notes: Uses official WHOOP OAuth API. Raw means upstream API JSON, not continuous sensor streams.
